title.narrative: IOM: African Union Free Movement Protocol (2022-2024)
IOM: African Union Free Movement Protocol (2022-2024)

description.narrative:
This projects objective is to contribute to the efforts of the AUC in accelerating the ratification and implementation of the Protocol Establishing the Free Movement of Persons, Right of Entry, Right of Residence and Right of Establishment Protocol (FMP). This will be achieved by providing support to the popularization of the Protocol; enhancing the technical capacity of the AUC to popularize the Free Movement Protocol; accelerating the ratification of the protocol by Member States; and enhancing advocacy of the protocol and the implementation roadmap.
The specific objectives / expected outcomes of the project are: 1. Evident increase in the popularization of the Protocol on Free Movement of Persons, Right of Entry, Right of Residence and Right of Establishment 2.National, regional, and continental institutions have increased their preparedness to facilitate free movement of persons, goods, and services in Africa

Syftet med det förslagna projektet att stödja det arbete som redan göras av den Afrikanska unionens kommission (AUC) för att påskynda ytterligare ratificeringar av Free Movement Protocol. Projektet avser stärka AUC:s tekniska kapacitet att stödja spridningen av protokollet, och stödja påverkansarbetet för påskyndandet av protokollets ratificering av fler medlemsländer.
Programmet genomförde en genusanalys i den inledande fasen och lämnade in en jämställdhetsintegreringsplan under samtliga aktiviteter. Dessutom inkluderades ett nytt resultatområde (resultat 3) informerad av genusanalysen med syftet att främja medlemsstaterna att ta itu med könsrelaterade risker i deras policyer för fri rörlighet och dess ratificeringsprocess. Programmet kommer att underlätta dialogen mellan migration och genusfokuserade ministerier i MS, REC och AU i syfte att påverka genomförandet av FMP.

This project’s objective is to contribute to the efforts of the AUC in accelerating the ratification and implementation of the Protocol Establishing the Free Movement of Persons, Right of Entry, Right of Residence and Right of Establishment Protocol (FMP). This will be achieved by providing support to the popularization of the Protocol; enhancing the technical capacity of the AUC to popularize the Free Movement Protocol; accelerating the ratification of the protocol by Member States; and enhancing advocacy of the protocol and the implementation roadmap.
The program conducted a gender analysis in the initial inception phase of the program, and submitted a gender mainstreaming plan under all activities.
In addition, a new outcome area -outcome 3-was included as a result of the gender analysis with the aim to promote Member States to consider and address gender related risks in the free movement policies and FMP ratification processes. The program will facilitate dialogue between migration and gender-focused ministries in MS, RECs, and AU with the aim to influence FMP implementation.

sector.narrative: Facilitation of orderly, safe, regular and responsible migration and mobility

description.narrative:
The third progress report has indicated a number of activities were undertaken during the reporting period from 01 April 2023 to 31 March 2024. The following are some of the progresses highlighted in the report:
-The program was able to recruit two staff to be seconded to AUC- a Senior Programme Officer and Policy Programming Officer- to support AUC in the roll-out of the project. The staff were on-boarded in the mid of 2023.
-High-level visit led by the AUC Commissioner for Health, Humanitarian Affairs and Social Development (HHS), Amb. Cessouma Minata Samate, to the Republic of Ghana to advocate for the ratification of the protocol
-Meeting with the AfCFTA Secretariat in Ghana, Secretary General, H.E. Wamkele Mene, to discuss advancing both FMP and the AfCFTA agreement together, given their evident inter-linkages.
-The program continued to engage youth, and youth ambassadors to advocate for the FMP in various platforms, and within their regions.
- Some knowledge products were also produced, such as an analysis on border governance and legal identity management in Africa, that is submitted to the AUC for validation, and research paper on the outlook of African Youth on Trade, Migration, and Mobility which are aimed to further push the FMP agenda with the integration of youth considerations.
-The program convened a session on border governance and management with MS representatives from intelligence, security services, the Single African Air Transport Market (SAATM) and others. The program assesses a need for capacity development of MS in the area of border management, and identity management systems, which they plan to focus on in a next phase.
-The program is working with governments and border offices to upgrade a mobile app that facilitates cross border document verification and to allow a system for scanning ID cards.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
